name: Refex Renewables & Infrastruct
summary: Refex Renewables & Infrastructure Ltd. specializes in real estate development and a range of infrastructure projects. The company's operations are divided into distinct segments: Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) for Rural applications, EPC for Commercial and Industrial (C&I) sectors, and an 'Others' category. Within the EPC-Rural division, the company handles the provision, setup, activation, and ongoing servicing of solar water pumps and home energy systems. Correspondingly, the EPC-Commercial and Industrial (C&I) segment is dedicated to the supply, installation, commissioning, and maintenance of both ground-mounted and rooftop solar power facilities. Established in 1959, the firm's main offices are situated in Chennai, India.
